snippet.title: Dune: Awakening | New DLC and Chapter 2 | Into the Infinite 2025
snippet.description:
A mysterious distress signal has been detected on Arrakis.

Dune: Awakening drops its first major post-launch update with a new story questline, expanded customization, and a sneak peek at the upcoming DLC featuring fresh content and cosmetic packs.

Play now: https://lvli.li/DUNEASTEAM 

Developed by Funcom
